lines: Magar bhulaana bhi chaahoon to kis tarah bhooloon
couplets.en: Even if I wanted to forget, how could I?

lines: Ki tum to phir bhi haqeeqat ho, koi khwaab nahin
couplets.en: You are real, after all, and dreams are easier to forget.

lines: Yahaan to dil ka ye aalam hai, kya kahoon
couplets.en: How can I say what state my heart is in?

lines: Bhula na paaya vo silsila jo tha hi nahin
couplets.en: I could never forget what had never been between us.

lines: Bhula na paaya vo silsila jo tha hi nahin
couplets.en: I could never forget what had never been between us.

lines: Vo ik khayaal jo aawaaz tak gaya hi nahin
couplets.en: There was a thought that never found a voice.

lines: Vo ek baat jo main keh nahin saka tumse
couplets.en: There was one thing I could never tell you.

lines: Vo ek rabt jo ham mein kabhi raha hi nahin
couplets.en: I recall a bond that never formed between us.

lines: Mujhe hai yaad vo sab jo kabhi hua hi nahin
couplets.en: I remember everything that never happened.

lines: Agar ye haal hai dil ka to koi samjhe
couplets.en: If this is how the heart feels, who could make sense of it?
